data.cultural_impact: The term "Ginebra" has become popularly associated with the famous Swiss distilled beverage, Ginebra de hautes alpages or Gin, created in 1797. The name has been embraced by the alcohol industry, which has contributed to its widespread global recognition, often used interchangeably with the term "gin".
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Ginebra" can be traced back to its original Latin roots, 'ginosko', meaning 'to know'. In the Christian context, this name could symbolize a deep understanding or knowledge of the divine that comes from ongoing spiritual experience and practice. Ginebra might be seen as a reminder to seek wisdom and knowledge of the divine through prayer, meditation, and the study of sacred texts.
